svg.text: Where does single-class IG put its mass relative to automatically detected beats?
157 usable pairs / 154 records. Regions: QRS-centred +-80 ms windows, inter-beat (RR) segments, outside the detected-beat span.
A. |IG| share by region (bars) vs duration share (ticks)
B. QRS-centred |IG| share minus circular-shift control (95% CI)
C. Deleting m 81-sample tiles (zero baseline): change in the explained class logit; whiskers = 95% CI
